name: theme-ocotillo
title: Ocotillo theme
description: OcotilloUI palette (brand blue and amber over neutral greys), light and dark. The default theme: it also applies when <html> has no data-theme.

files.content:
/* Ocotillo theme: the palette OcotilloUI ships today (its src/index.css on
   staging, which its shadcn components use). The Ocotillo brand blue ramp,
   amber, red, orange, emerald and teal, over neutral greys. OcotilloUI
   writes these in oklch; they're converted to hex here, with the Tailwind
   (v4) or brand step named alongside. Tokens OcotilloUI doesn't define
   (soft/strong, tones, charts, on-image) are filled in from the same ramps.

   This is the default theme: it also matches <html> with no data-theme, so
   apps that never set one keep this look. Defines the whole token contract
   (see THEMING.md). */

:root:not([data-theme]),
:root[data-theme="ocotillo"] {
    --background: #fafafa;        /* neutral-50 */
    --foreground: #0f1521;        /* slate-900 */
    --card: #ffffff;              /* white (paper) */
    --card-foreground: #0f1521;
    --popover: #ffffff;
    --popover-foreground: #0f1521;

    --primary: #0e6da8;          /* brand-600 */
    --primary-foreground: #ffffff;
    --primary-light: #83c6ee;    /* brand-300 */
    --primary-dark: #0f5786;     /* brand-700 */

    --secondary: #dd7500;        /* amber-600 */
    --secondary-foreground: #ffffff;
    --secondary-strong: #b45309; /* amber-700 */
    --secondary-dark: #973f02;   /* amber-800 */

    --muted: #f2f2f2;            /* neutral-100 */
    --muted-foreground: #737373; /* neutral-500 */
    --accent: #ebebeb;           /* neutral-150 (hover) */
    --accent-foreground: #0f1521;
    --destructive: #e7000b;      /* red-600 */
    --warning-light: #fdba74;    /* orange-300 */
    --warning-dark: #c2410c;     /* orange-700 */

    --success: #007a55; /* emerald-700 */
    --success-foreground: #ffffff;
    --success-soft: #d1fae5; /* emerald-100 */
    --success-strong: #065f46; /* emerald-800 */
    --warning: #fa7005; /* orange-500 */
    --warning-foreground: #ffffff;
    --warning-soft: #ffedd5; /* orange-100 */
    --warning-strong: #9a3412; /* orange-800 */
    --info: #00786f; /* teal-700 */
    --info-foreground: #ffffff;
    --info-soft: #cbfbf1; /* teal-100 */
    --info-strong: #005f5a; /* teal-800 */
    --destructive-foreground: #ffffff;
    --destructive-soft: #fee2e2; /* red-100 */
    --destructive-strong: #b91c1c; /* red-700 */

    --border: #dedede;           /* neutral-200 */
    --input: #dedede;
    --ring: #0e6da8;             /* brand-600 */

    --chart-1: #0e6da8;          /* brand-600 */
    --chart-2: #dd7500;          /* amber-600 */
    --chart-3: #007a55;          /* emerald-700 */
    --chart-4: #009689;          /* teal-600 */
    --chart-5: #e7000b;          /* red-600 */

    --tone-1: #0e6da8; /* brand-600 */
    --tone-1-foreground: #ffffff;
    --tone-1-soft: #dceffb; /* brand-100 */
    --tone-1-strong: #12496e; /* brand-800 */
    --tone-2: #b45309; /* amber-700 */
    --tone-2-foreground: #ffffff;
    --tone-2-soft: #fef3c7; /* amber-100 */
    --tone-2-strong: #92400e; /* amber-800 */
    --tone-3: #047857; /* emerald-700 */
    --tone-3-foreground: #ffffff;
    --tone-3-soft: #d1fae5; /* emerald-100 */
    --tone-3-strong: #065f46; /* emerald-800 */
    --tone-4: #475569; /* slate-600 */
    --tone-4-foreground: #ffffff;
    --tone-4-soft: #f1f5f9; /* slate-100 */
    --tone-4-strong: #1e293b; /* slate-800 */
    --tone-5: #6d28d9; /* violet-700 */
    --tone-5-foreground: #ffffff;
    --tone-5-soft: #ede9fe; /* violet-100 */
    --tone-5-strong: #5b21b6; /* violet-800 */
    --tone-6: #00786f; /* teal-700 */
    --tone-6-foreground: #ffffff;
    --tone-6-soft: #cbfbf1; /* teal-100 */
    --tone-6-strong: #005f5a; /* teal-800 */

    --radius: 0.375rem;

    --sidebar: #fafafa;           /* neutral-50, matches --background */
    --sidebar-foreground: #0f1521;
    --sidebar-primary: #0e6da8;
    --sidebar-primary-foreground: #ffffff;
    --sidebar-accent: #ebebeb;    /* neutral-150 (hover) */
    --sidebar-accent-foreground: #0f1521;
    --sidebar-border: #dedede;
    --sidebar-ring: #0e6da8;

    --font-heading: 'Outfit Variable', system-ui, sans-serif;
    --font-sans: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif;

    /* Content on photos and dark bands. Same in light and dark. */
    --on-image: #ffffff;
    --on-image-muted: #e2e8f0; /* slate-200 */
    --on-image-surface: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12);
    --on-image-border: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5);
    --on-image-ring: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7);
    --accent-on-dark: #fcd34d; /* amber-300 */
}

:root:not([data-theme]).dark,
:root[data-theme="ocotillo"].dark {
    --background: #181818;        /* neutral-900 */
    --foreground: #f0f4f8;        /* slate-100 */
    --card: #404040;              /* neutral-700 (paper) */
    --card-foreground: #f0f4f8;
    --popover: #404040;
    --popover-foreground: #f0f4f8;

    --primary: #83c6ee;          /* brand-300 */
    --primary-foreground: #181818;
    --primary-light: #47a6dd;    /* brand-400 */
    /* OcotilloUI's dark --primary-dark is brand-200, a lighter hover shade.
       Here primary-dark is the band color behind on-image text (Hero, the
       inverse button), so it stays a deep brand-700 in both modes. */
    --primary-dark: #0f5786;     /* brand-700 */

    --secondary: #f2da4e;        /* amber-300 */
    --secondary-foreground: #181818;
    --secondary-strong: #b45309; /* amber-700 */
    --secondary-dark: #973f02;   /* amber-800 */

    --muted: #272727;            /* neutral-800 */
    --muted-foreground: #97a1ae; /* slate-400 */
    --accent: #272727;           /* neutral-800 */
    --accent-foreground: #f0f4f8;
    --destructive: #ff6467;      /* red-400 */
    --warning-light: #fdba74;    /* orange-300 */
    --warning-dark: #c2410c;     /* orange-700 */

    --success: #5ee9b5; /* emerald-300 */
    --success-foreground: #181818;
    --success-soft: #064e3b; /* emerald-900 */
    --success-strong: #a7f3d0; /* emerald-200 */
    --warning: #ffb86a; /* orange-300 */
    --warning-foreground: #181818;
    --warning-soft: #7c2d12; /* orange-900 */
    --warning-strong: #fed7aa; /* orange-200 */
    --info: #5eead4; /* teal-300 */
    --info-foreground: #181818;
    --info-soft: #0b4f4a; /* teal-900 */
    --info-strong: #96f7e4; /* teal-200 */
    --destructive-foreground: #1c0505;
    --destructive-soft: #7f1d1d; /* red-900 */
    --destructive-strong: #fca5a5; /* red-300 */

    --border: #404040;           /* neutral-700 */
    --input: #272727;            /* neutral-800 */
    --ring: #83c6ee;             /* brand-300 */

    --chart-1: #83c6ee;          /* brand-300 */
    --chart-2: #f2da4e;          /* amber-300 */
    --chart-3: #5ee9b5;          /* emerald-300 */
    --chart-4: #5eead4;          /* teal-300 */
    --chart-5: #ff6467;          /* red-400 */

    --tone-1: #47a6dd; /* brand-400 */
    --tone-1-foreground: #0d273c; /* brand-950 */
    --tone-1-soft: #143d5b; /* brand-900 */
    --tone-1-strong: #b8dff6; /* brand-200 */
    --tone-2: #fbbf24; /* amber-400 */
    --tone-2-foreground: #451a03; /* amber-950 */
    --tone-2-soft: #78350f; /* amber-900 */
    --tone-2-strong: #fde68a; /* amber-200 */
    --tone-3: #34d399; /* emerald-400 */
    --tone-3-foreground: #022c22; /* emerald-950 */
    --tone-3-soft: #064e3b; /* emerald-900 */
    --tone-3-strong: #a7f3d0; /* emerald-200 */
    --tone-4: #94a3b8; /* slate-400 */
    --tone-4-foreground: #0f172a; /* slate-900 */
    --tone-4-soft: #334155; /* slate-700 */
    --tone-4-strong: #e2e8f0; /* slate-200 */
    --tone-5: #a78bfa; /* violet-400 */
    --tone-5-foreground: #2e1065; /* violet-950 */
    --tone-5-soft: #4c1d95; /* violet-900 */
    --tone-5-strong: #ddd6fe; /* violet-200 */
    --tone-6: #00d5be; /* teal-400 */
    --tone-6-foreground: #022f2e; /* teal-950 */
    --tone-6-soft: #0b4f4a; /* teal-900 */
    --tone-6-strong: #96f7e4; /* teal-200 */

    --sidebar: #272727;          /* neutral-800 */
    --sidebar-foreground: #f0f4f8;
    --sidebar-primary: #83c6ee;  /* brand-300 */
    --sidebar-primary-foreground: #181818;
    --sidebar-accent: #404040;   /* neutral-700 */
    --sidebar-accent-foreground: #f0f4f8;
    --sidebar-border: #404040;
    --sidebar-ring: #83c6ee;
}

docs: Import after ds-base.css: @import "./styles/themes/ocotillo.css". Setting <html data-theme="ocotillo"> is optional.
